facts.fact: The CNDP states that Law 09-08 on the protection of individuals regarding personal data processing, promulgated by Dahir 1-09-15 of 18 February 2009 (BO 5714 of 5 March 2009), governs AI processing of personal data.
The CNDP, created by the Dahir promulgating Law 09-08, says it supervises compliance of data processing, including AI, with that law.
